signIn.title: Sign in to Campbooks
signIn.lead: What needs you, in one calm place. Campbooks reads your mail and brings you only what needs you.
signIn.invitedTitle: Sign in to join the workspace
signIn.invitedLead: Use the email address the invitation was sent to, and you’ll join straight away.

gmail.summary: Google will also ask to let Campbooks use your Gmail, so your first mailbox is ready when you are.
gmail.keeps: Campbooks keeps your name, your address and the permission Google gives it. It never sees your Google password.
gmail.reads: That permission lets Campbooks read and organise the mail in this Gmail account. Nothing is connected to a workspace until you say so, and a permission you don’t use is deleted after 7 days.
gmail.optional: You can untick mail access on Google’s screen. You’ll still be signed in, and your mail simply won’t be connected.
gmail.existing: If you already have an account, signing in doesn’t change any mailbox you’ve connected.

signIn.unverified: Google may warn that it hasn’t verified this app. Google checks every app that can read Gmail, and that check isn’t finished yet. To carry on, choose “Advanced”, then continue to the app.
signIn.footer: Open source. Your mail stays in your workspace.
signIn.loading: Loading the ways to sign in…

noWayIn.title: Signing in isn’t set up yet
noWayIn.lead: This Campbooks has no way to sign in turned on. Ask whoever runs it to set up Google sign-in.

expired.title: This sign-in page has expired
expired.lead: It waited too long. Start again; nothing was lost.

failed.title: Couldn’t load the ways to sign in
failed.lead: Campbooks didn’t answer. Check your connection, then try again.

cancelled_at_provider.title: You cancelled on the sign-in screen.
cancelled_at_provider.lead: Nothing was created. Choose a way to sign in when you’re ready.

invalid_state.title: That sign-in can’t be finished.
invalid_state.lead: It took too long, or it was opened in another browser. Start again in this one.

provider_unavailable.title: The sign-in provider didn’t answer.
provider_unavailable.lead: Nothing changed. Wait a moment, then try again.

login_failed.title: The sign-in provider couldn’t confirm who you are.
login_failed.lead: Try again, or sign in another way.

account_disabled.title: This account is turned off.
account_disabled.lead: Ask whoever runs this Campbooks to turn it back on.

way_in_belongs_to_another_account.title: This account already signs in to another Campbooks account.
way_in_belongs_to_another_account.lead: Sign in with it to use that account.

unknown.title: Something went wrong while signing in.

newAccount.title: Create your Campbooks account
newAccount.leadNoEmail: No Campbooks account uses this {{provider}} account yet.
newAccount.nameNote: This is the name {{provider}} gave us. People in your workspaces will see it.
newAccount.next1: Your account is created, and you sign in with this {{provider}} account.
newAccount.next3: If you let Campbooks use your mail, you choose whether to connect it to that workspace.
newAccount.footer: Already use Campbooks with another account? Sign in with that one instead.

gone.title: This sign-up isn’t waiting any more
gone.lead: It took too long, or it was started in another browser. Sign in again to start over.

loadFailed.title: Couldn’t load your new account
loadFailed.lead: Campbooks didn’t answer. Check your connection, then try again.

mailbox.title: Your Gmail {{address}} will be connected to this workspace
mailbox.titleOther: Your mailbox {{address}} will be connected to this workspace
mailbox.lead: Campbooks reads the mail in it, keeps a copy of what it reads so it can show it to you here, and keeps checking for new mail.
mailbox.later: Not now keeps it waiting on Home until {{date}}.
mailbox.signIn: Disconnecting it later doesn’t stop you signing in with this account.

gone.title: That mailbox isn’t waiting any more.
gone.lead: Its permission expired or was already used, so it can’t be connected from here.

taken.title: Someone else here already connected it.
taken.lead: Another member of this workspace connected {{address}}.

unsupported.title: Campbooks can’t read this mailbox yet.

offer.title: Connect {{address}}
offer.lead: This mailbox has been waiting since you signed up. Connect it to {{workspace}} and Campbooks will bring what needs you here.
offer.confirmForget: Forget {{address}}? Campbooks deletes the permission Google gave it. You can still sign in with this account.
